The changes are complete. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Summary of Changes

### New Configuration (lines 55-70)

```javascript
const selectorConfig = {
  avoidIdPatterns: [/^radix-/],      // Skip auto-generated Radix IDs
  preferClassPatterns: [/^xx--/, /^oo--/],  // Prioritize semantic classes
  avoidClassPatterns: [/^elpicker-/]  // Skip our own classes
};
```

### New Helper Functions

1. **`isIdAllowed(id)`** - Returns `false` for IDs matching `radix-*` pattern
2. **`sortClassesByPreference(classes)`** - Sorts classes so `xx--*` and `oo--*` appear first

### Updated Functions

- **`getCssSelector`** - Now uses preference sorting for classes and skips `radix-` IDs
- **`getXPath`** - Also skips `radix-` IDs
- **`getBreadcrumb`** - Uses same filtering/preference logic
- **Overlay display** - Shows preferred classes first

### Example Behavior

Given an element with:
```html
<div id="radix-123" class="flex items-center xx--button oo--submit">
```

**Before:** `#radix-123`
**After:** `div.xx--button.oo--submit`

The selector now:
- Avoids the auto-generated `#radix-123` ID
- Uses the semantic `xx--button` and `oo--submit` classes instead
- Falls back to other classes if no preferred ones exist

The configuration system is now in place. Here's what was added:

## Summary of Changes

### Popup UI (`popup.html`)
Added a collapsible "Selector Settings" panel with three text areas:
- **Preferred Class Patterns** - Regex patterns prioritized in selectors (default: `^xx--`, `^oo--`)
- **Avoided Class Patterns** - Regex patterns excluded from selectors (default: `^elpicker-`)
- **Avoided ID Patterns** - ID patterns to skip (default: `^radix-`)

### Popup Logic (`popup.js`)
- Loads/saves settings via `chrome.storage.sync`
- Validates regex patterns before saving
- Notifies content script when config changes
- Reset button restores defaults

### Content Script (`content.js`)
- Config is now mutable and loaded from storage on init
- `applySelectorConfig()` converts string patterns to RegExp objects
- Listens for `configUpdated` message to apply changes live
- Always includes `^elpicker-` in avoided patterns (can't be removed)

### Usage
1. Click the gear icon in the popup to expand settings
2. Enter regex patterns, one per line
3. Click "Save" to apply
4. Settings sync across devices via Chrome sync storage

### Example Patterns
```
^xx--          # Classes starting with xx--
^oo--          # Classes starting with oo--
^radix-        # IDs starting with radix-
^data-v-       # Vue scoped style hashes
__[a-z0-9]+$   # CSS module hashes at end
```
